objective: Definir el contrato puro de reversos, cancelaciones y devoluciones de beneficios Cavas mediante eventos compensatorios. Una aplicacion confirmada nunca se borra ni se reescribe. Todo reverso crea un nuevo evento enlazado a la aplicacion original, con monto compensado, razon, origen y evidencia del proveedor. No DDL, no escritura directa al POS/ERP, no inventar reversos.

actions.content:
import pytest

from modules.cava_socios.domain import (
    BenefitCompensationEvent,
    BenefitCompensationKind,
    BenefitCompensationStatus,
    compensation_mutates_original_application,
    remaining_effective_benefit,
    validate_benefit_compensation,
)


def _event(**overrides):
    data = dict(
        compensation_id="COMP-1",
        original_application_id="APP-1",
        kind=BenefitCompensationKind.FULL_REVERSAL,
        amount=100.0,
        currency="MXN",
        reason="Cuenta cancelada en proveedor",
        source_system="POS-CANONICAL",
        source_transaction_id="TX-1",
    )
    data.update(overrides)
    return BenefitCompensationEvent(**data)


def test_full_reversal_requires_exact_original_amount():
    validate_benefit_compensation(_event(), original_adjustment_amount=100.0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_benefit_compensation(_event(amount=50.0), original_adjustment_amount=100.0)


def test_partial_reversal_must_be_less_than_original():
    validate_benefit_compensation(_event(kind=BenefitCompensationKind.PARTIAL_REVERSAL, amount=40.0), original_adjustment_amount=100.0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_benefit_compensation(_event(kind=BenefitCompensationKind.PARTIAL_REVERSAL, amount=100.0), original_adjustment_amount=100.0)


def test_compensation_cannot_exceed_original_benefit():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_benefit_compensation(_event(amount=101.0), original_adjustment_amount=100.0)


def test_confirmed_compensation_requires_provider_evidence():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_benefit_compensation(_event(status=BenefitCompensationStatus.CONFIRMED), original_adjustment_amount=100.0)
    validate_benefit_compensation(_event(
        status=BenefitCompensationStatus.CONFIRMED,
        provider_reference="POS-REV-1",
        evidence_reference="EVID-REV-1",
    ), original_adjustment_amount=100.0)


def test_remaining_effective_benefit_uses_only_confirmed_compensations():
    confirmed = _event(
        kind=BenefitCompensationKind.PARTIAL_REVERSAL,
        amount=25.0,
        status=BenefitCompensationStatus.CONFIRMED,
        provider_reference="POS-REV-1",
        evidence_reference="EVID-REV-1",
    )
    failed = _event(
        compensation_id="COMP-2",
        kind=BenefitCompensationKind.PARTIAL_REVERSAL,
        amount=25.0,
        status=BenefitCompensationStatus.FAILED,
    )
    assert remaining_effective_benefit(original_adjustment_amount=100.0, confirmed_compensations=(confirmed, failed)) == 75.0


def test_original_application_is_immutable():
    assert compensation_mutates_original_application() is False

constraints: NO borrar ni reescribir la aplicacion original confirmada
Todo reverso/cancelacion/devolucion es evento compensatorio nuevo
La compensacion no puede superar el beneficio original
CONFIRMED requiere referencia real del proveedor y evidencia
Solo compensaciones confirmadas reducen el beneficio economico efectivo
No inventar reverso cuando el proveedor no lo haya confirmado
